decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing the USB-C port as the ESP32 programming port; locating the separate auxiliary LDO on the main board does not alter the native USB data or flashing requirements.
Locating the standalone USB auxiliary LDO on the main board does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its normal-operation role when the power board is connected.
The main-board location of the standalone USB auxiliary regulator does not change the LED daughterboard's count, part, form, or supply requirement.

The candidate already records the same message's independently supported LED connector placement; the auxiliary USB LDO location does not change LED power, level shifting, GPIO, or interconnect state.
The auxiliary LDO's main-board location does not change the existing I2C pull-up location, resistor policy, routing, speed, or cable constraints.
Panel-control connectors and the BOOT button are independently established by the source message, but their state is not changed by the standalone USB regulator's board placement.
The source places the standalone 3.3V USB LDO on the main board but does not change the separate MT3608 5V boost rail, its enable control, loads, or interboard routing.
Assigning the auxiliary LDO to the already-existing main board does not change the number or identity of the project's separate boards.
The standalone USB regulator's location does not change the established interboard connector partition, connector types, pinout, or matching policy.
The auxiliary USB LDO placement does not alter the battery-charge status display method, external charge-LED connector, resistor values, or population requirements.
The source confirms a separate main-board LDO for standalone operation without changing the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal-operation power source.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing the exact ESP32 module model; locating the auxiliary LDO on the main board does not alter module selection.
